name: promega-workspace-engineering
description: Promega engineering workspace for every Promega engineer — shaped for the Promega Project Planner V3 Visualizer (Windows Electron desktop app, filesystem-only). Creates a Personal Workspace with Projects/ and Meetings/ mounts plus optional engineer-selected add-ons (Change Controls/, DS Revisions/, Commissioning/, Documentation/, custom). Three-tier knowledge search (workspace → SharePoint → general), Outlook meeting sync via Microsoft 365 Plus with full transcript and recording support (Attendees Name+Email+Response, Recurrence, Recording link), ISA-88/FactoryTalk Batch reference tuned to FERMB, /save-summary and /save-note for knowledge capture, /add-project for scaffolding. Works for any Promega engineering team: process, automation, controls/instrumentation, validation, manufacturing, IT/OT. Uses the Microsoft 365 Plus connector — requires it enabled in Claude Customize.
